## HERA — resolve the censored onset before committing the fan

> **05:20** · Fan onset preflight: n=+3.2e12 D\_A=0, B 0.3 to 1.5 T, 268 inverse-B points, 50 uV, base T · **ETA ~05:50** (≈30 min)

`sdh-spot-check` and `landau-fan-vti` step 1 require a measured onset for the cheapest adequate fan. Run 6 / ana cell 15 returns a censored 7.3 T tone at the adequately sampled 1 T edge; its 50 mT points below 1 T cannot pin onset for F_L=33.09 T. Extend the same n=+3.2e12 cm^-2, D_A=0 point over 0.3–1.5 T, 268 inverse-B points (Δ1/B=0.00999 T^-1, 3.02 samples/F_L period), retaining 50 µV sensitivity and the driver's 3 s settle (10τ). The overlap checks acquisition reproducibility; this is the binding preflight for the requested electron fan, not a stacking claim.

The read-only preconditions compare all committed caps to the device card and check the handoff field, live thermometry, heaters, bias, contact map and acquisition settings. Field motion from 0 to 1.5 T costs 1.5/0.137=10.95 min; runs 6/7 measured about 3.1 s non-ramp overhead per point, giving 14 min more, plus reads/guard margin. Check first 20 points then completion for leakage, clipping and reproducibility. Leave field at 1.5 T and gates at the electron spot for the fan; no Si movement or pacing change. On interruption, read actual field again: the VTI magnet can continue to its last commanded target.

 assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
_T0,_Tv,_B0,_Si=T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field(),k_si()
print('Expected: base 1.0..1.5 K, vaporizer <1.6 K, field near 0 T, Si 0 V. Actual:',_T0,_Tv,_B0,_Si)
assert 1.0<=_T0<=1.5 and .5<_Tv<1.6 and abs(_Tv-_T0)<.6
assert abs(_B0)<.05 and abs(_Si)<.01

assert heater.sample_range()==0 and heater.vaporizer_range()==0

assert sr0.time_constant()==.3 and sr1.time_constant()==.3 and sr0.filter_slope()==24 and sr1.filter_slope()==24
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
assert k_tg.volt.step==.005 and k_bg.volt.step==.005
assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
CAL=dict(c_tg=.002796,c_bg=.002161,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
# Nyquist on F_L=33.09 T with ~3 samples/cycle throughout.
B_vec=1/np.linspace(1/.3,1/1.5,268)
vt,vb=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0,**CAL)
for v in [vt]: k_tg.volt.validate(float(v))
for v in [vb]: k_bg.volt.validate(float(v))
for b in B_vec: magnet.field.validate(float(b))
assert magnet.settle_s>=3
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)

s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(mc['comments'])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(vb)); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(vt)); interruptible_sleep(10)
# [time,B,T_sample,T_vaporizer,I_tg,I_bg,sr0X,sr0P,sr1X,sr1P]
for p in [T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P]:
 s.fp(p); s.plot('time',p)
def onset_guard(station,data):
 if max(abs(float(data[4])),abs(float(data[5])))>1e-9 or abs(float(data[8]))>45e-6 or not 1.0<float(data[2])<1.5:
  print('ONSET QUALITY STOP',data); station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(onset_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0)
print('ONSET END actual field/gates:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt())
